name: Big Tony
description:
Big Tony is a delightful, people-loving boy who gets very excited when meeting new faces! He can be big, bouncy and a little pingy, sometimes forgetting just how large he is when his excitement takes over. He loves exploring new places and enjoys playing with toys, both independently and with his favourite people. Although he has a playful side, Big Tony is generally a chilled-out chap who is happy to relax once he's settled. He would love a home with use of a garden or outdoor space where he can enjoy a bit of playtime and unwind. Big Tony will need his leaving hours built up gradually to help him feel comfortable being left alone.

Big Tony can be quite intense when initially meeting other dogs, but once he's said hello, he tends to become an independent and calm boy. He could potentially share his home with another dog, providing they are a suitable match. Big Tony cannot live with cats or small furries. Due to his large, enthusiastic and bouncy nature, he would be best suited to a home with older secondary-school-aged children who are confident around dogs and ideally have experience with larger, playful breeds. If you're looking for a fun-loving companion who enjoys human company, adventures, playtime and plenty of opportunities to relax, Big Tony could be the boy for you!

name: Lilly
description:
Meet beautiful girl, Lilly! Lilly is a 5.5-year old Husky looking for her forever home. Lilly could live with a resident dog, pending a successful meet in the centre but mealtimes will need to be managed as she has guarded her food from other dogs before. Any children in the home should be of secondary school age and above, as she loves people but in typical Husky style, likes her independence too. 
Lilly is a really sweet-natured, calm girl with a wonderful temperament. She is mostly unbothered by dogs, so would be just as happy being the only dog in the home, but any doggy friends should be polite and calm. 
Lilly can be goofy and bouncy when seeing her friends, and absolutely loves a cuddle with her people. She loves her walks and adventures, where she can get all her sniffs in. She absolutely loves water and having a paddle, so would love an active family that are willing to take her out and about! Lilly loves her toys, but would prefer to be left alone when playing with them. We cannot wait for this gorgeous girl to find her forever home!

Lilly is such a sweet girl who is missing her home comforts. She settles well in her kennel, so we think this would translate really well into home life. Lilly would prefer a family that are home for most of the day at first as she prefers to not be left alone for too long. She may also need a bit of reminding of her toilet training in a new environment but does her best to keep her space clean. 
Lilly would prefer a quieter home to suit her calmer nature, but would love an active home to keep her brain busy. She does have sensitive skin, so will need lifelong management of this with supplements. Lilly is an outdoorsy girl, so would love her own garden to potter around and lie down in.
Lilly cannot wait to meet her forever family!

name: Kevin
description: Meet our handsome boy Kevin! This gorgeous lad really loves using his nose whether that be for exploring on his walks or playing some scent games like "find it" especially when it involves a tasty treat! Kevin can be a bit worried when he sees people he doesn't know but warms up quite quickly and will snuggle up on the sofa with you resting his head on your shoulder to show his love! Once he gets to know you, Kevin will show off his silly and goofy personality. Squeaky toys are his favourite, especially rubber ones, and he would happily play with them all day! Kevin is looking for someone to be home most of the day with him to start with and then to help him build up the time he can be left by himself. Kevin has made some doggy friends here at the centre but can be a bit vocal out on walks when he wants to say hi to them, but this is something he is working on and making great progress with. Kevin's favourite pastime is getting all the cuddles and belly rubs from his favourite people and he would happily live with secondary school aged children and above. If you are looking for an active snuggle bug then Kevin could be the boy for you! AWE licence number 13090 by West Lothian Council.

name: Raven
description:
Raven is a 2 year old Cane Corso who arrived into our care with her puppies. She hasn't had the best start in life but has been enjoying life in foster whilst she raised her puppies and now, that they have all been rehomed, she is looking for a forever home of her own! Raven is looking to be the only pet in the home as she can be reactive to other dogs, but can make friends with confident dogs if introduced carefully.

This gorgeous girl loves her home comforts and you can often find her snoozing away on the sofa! Her ideal home would be someone strong enough to handle her strength on the lead, around for most of the day and committed to her training. Raven knows quite a few tricks already, but is always up for learning more. Animal Welfare licence number is AWE02, as licenced by Glasgow City Council.

name: Meadow
description:
Meadow is a lively, energetic young dog who’s searching for an owner ready to match her enthusiasm for life. At just under 2, this Malinois x Lurcher is incredibly fast, playful, and loves to play fetch. She would thrive in a calm home environment, ideally away from busy or noisy roads. Meadow needs direct access to a private, secure garden with fencing of at least 5ft. When out and about, she should be kept on a lead, and a muzzle is recommended in more stressful/crowded situations. An active, adult only home would suit her best, especially with someone around for most of the day to help her settle in.

Meadow is an intelligent girl with plenty of potential, though she’s still learning and developing her skills. She’s highly motivated by toys and food, which makes training both rewarding and fun. While she enjoys playing other dogs on walks, she would be best suited as the only pet for now. She'd love to find a training focused owner who can keep her mind engaged and continue the progress she’s already made. Meadow has come a long way during her time in care, and ongoing support from our behaviour team will be provided to help her and her new family succeed. Meadow is going to make a very rewarding dog for someone willing to give her the time, love and support she needs. Animal Welfare licence number is AWE02, as licenced by Glasgow City Council.

name: Tayto
description:
Tayto and Pringle are two young Chihuahua x Whippets who are very worried souls that find the world quite overwhelming. Tayto is the more confident of the pair, but they both get a lot of comfort from each other and enjoy snuggling up together in bed too. Tayto and Pringle are hoping to find a patient and loving family who can help build their confidence up and treasure them! Tayto loves to be next to you and climb in your lap for some snuggles, whereas Pringle is a little more timid, but does love his snacks and some scratches.

Their ideal home would be a quieter environment with a patient and understanding family, who are around for most of the day. Having direct access into their own secure garden would be perfect, especially whilst they are working on their confidence. Any time that they are left home alone, should be very gradually built up over time. Animal Welfare licence number is AWE02, as licenced by Glasgow City Council.

name: Rocco
description:
Rocco could live with children of secondary school age, but he will need to be the only pet, with no other dogs or animals. Rocco loves being around people and can quickly become your little shadow, finding it difficult when left alone. For this reason, he will need a home where time spent alone is kept to a minimum initially, with his confidence gradually built up so he can manage being left for a few hours at a time. A home where someone is around for much of the day would be ideal while he settles in and learns that being alone isn't so worrying.

Rocco is a 3-year-old Spaniel who came into our care through no fault of his own. He is a lovely boy who adores his toys and enjoys soaking up attention from his favourite people. Rocco is currently enjoying life in foster care, where he is taking a little time to decompress and settle, but each day we are seeing more and more of his wonderful personality shine through. He loves being close to his people and feels most settled when he can be near you, even at night. As a typical Spaniel, Rocco enjoys getting out and about on his walks and will need an active home that can keep up with his enthusiasm! He can pull on the lead at times, so some ongoing training will be beneficial. Rocco can also feel a little unsure around other dogs, so continued positive experiences and confidence-building around them would help him feel more comfortable. One thing is for sure, Rocco is a real foodie and absolutely loves his meals!

name: Mollie
description:
Mollie is a 3-year-old female Cross-Breed dog with stunning blue eyes, currently residing in Blackpool.

She’s a delightful companion, often found cuddled up on the sofa, cherishing moments of warmth and affection.

While walks might not be her forte due to her nervousness on the lead, she does appreciate having a garden to explore and roam freely.

In terms of companionship, Mollie is excellent with cats, displaying a friendly disposition towards them. However, she prefers to be the sole dog in the household, as she thrives better without canine companions.

Particularly, Mollie gravitates towards female company, making a female-only household her ideal environment.

Mollie has been neutered and is dual-chipped, ensuring her safety and compliance with regulations.

Given her preference for a tranquil environment, Mollie’s ideal home would be without children, providing her with the peace and stability she craves.

name: Merlin
description:
Merlin is a medium-sized boy who cannot live with cats or children, but he can live with female dogs. He is currently based in Cheshire.

Merlin is a neutered male dog who is fully vaccinated and microchipped. He is not currently on any medication.

Merlin has a calm demeanour when strangers visit the home, often ignoring them in favour of a walk. He may show excitement and jump up when greeting familiar people.

Merlin has displayed resource guarding tendencies, particularly with food and his owner. He is fed separately from the smaller dog in the home to prevent food theft and used to protect “high value” treats, though this behaviour has improved since such treats were removed from his routine.

He has also shown possessiveness over his owner, particularly in interactions with her new partner, though he eventually accepted him.

Merlin accepts a collar, harness, and lead without issue. On walks, he demonstrates strength but remains generally calm and checks back with his handler.

While walking, he showed excitement upon seeing a German Shepherd, which escalated into lunging and barking, accompanied by a slight growl and a curled lip.

Merlin is toilet-trained but not crate-trained. He has never been destructive and can be left alone without issues, he spends two days a week unattended from 8:30 AM to 3:00 PM. Overnight, he sleeps well in his safe space under the stairs.

While Merlin travels well in a vehicle, he tends to wander. A strong restraint or boot guard would be needed for safe car travel.

Merlin enjoys walks, tug-of-war, teddies, food, attention, and grooming. He has gained weight due to reduced exercise following his owner’s back injury, and he would benefit from increased activity.

He dislikes cats, children, hosepipes, sprinklers and visits to the vet where he experiences stress in waiting rooms, especially around other animals, and is muzzled as a precaution.

Merlin is a high-energy dog who can be playful and gently mouths arms when excited.

name: Larry
description:
Larry is a 2 year old male hound cross who was born in May 2021 and is currently in a foster home in Oman.

Larry was rescued two years ago after he was reported living on the streets in an area that is dangerous for dogs. Unfortunately, we got to Larry’s friend too late and he was poisoned before we could rescue him but we luckily managed to rescue Larry.

He is a timid guy who’s wary of new people. This is unsurprising as he was treated badly on the streets, he had rocks thrown at him and was shouted at. He never associated humans with kindness.

He has been in a foster home with other dogs for over one year and has come on a long way. He will need a home with at least one other dog to make him feel more comfortable.

He will need very kind and patient owners who are understanding of his past and he will need time to settle in, trust and gain confidence. Larry is currently living with cats.

He is leash-trained and will go out for walks with the other dogs. He is not used to being around young children so a quieter home/ older children would be best for him.

He is healthy, weighs around 22kg, is neutered and is fully vaccinated. He is ready to travel to the UK now.

name: Roxie
description:
Roxie is a delightful almost 4-year-old female cross-breed dog currently being fostered in the Poole.

She has shown remarkable adaptability during her journey to her foster home, indicating she travels well. Roxie is lead and harness trained, making walks a joy for both her and her owner.

Moreover, she’s already toilet trained, easing the transition into any new home environment.

Regarding her interactions with other pets, Roxie is described as “dog savvy” with cats, implying she can coexist peacefully with feline companions.

However, she’s not suitable for living with other dogs, as she exhibits reactivity towards them during walks. Therefore, it’s essential for Roxie to be the sole dog in her new home.

Additionally, she’s deemed suitable for households with older children aged 15 and above.

Despite her minor reactivity issue with other dogs, Roxie is affectionate and enjoys spending time with her human family, including cuddles and learning new commands.

A secure garden would be ideal for her to exercise and play freely.

To ensure her safety during walks, it’s recommended to use a no-escape harness.

name: Benny
description:
Benny is a 3 year old male crossbreed, currently at our shelter in Southern Spain but can travel to the UK.

Rescued from a municipal pound, Benny is a lovely happy-go-lucky dog who is great with people – he especially loves children and helping them to put away their toys!

He is an active dog who loves to run and play with other dogs at the shelter, and more than anything he loves sniffing and will spend most of his outside time pottering around the trees and bushes.

He can show dominant behaviours with male dogs and doesn’t like them entering his kennel space, but is fine around them when he is outside. He prefers females but if a male dog is relaxed, he is happy to be around them.

He is playful and really loves his walks but when he returns to his kennel, he is quite calm and happily waits until his next walk. Benny would suit an active home who will take him on lots of long walks and make sure that he gets lots of appropriate enrichment.

All of our dogs have an international passport (unless born in the UK) and are microchipped. They are fully vaccinated for standard diseases as well as rabies and kennel cough.

All dogs are blood tested for infectious diseases including Leishmaniasis, Dirofilaria, Ehrlichia, Babesia, Anaplasma, Lyme and Brucella. All dogs, unless there are medical or behavioural reasons to not do so, will be sterilised.

Benny is neutered. Please note that we will advise results and treatments upon successful application.

Adoption contract and fee, homecheck and lifetime RBU (rescue back-up) apply as standard.

name: Clove
description:
Clove is a medium-sized 1 year old female Cross-Breed who cannot live with cats, dogs, or children. She is currently based in Cheshire.

Clove has recently been diagnosed as deaf, she will need a family who have experience with deaf dogs and can continue working with her.

Clove currently shares a kennel with two other dogs and is fine with them, these dogs are her mother and father, she hasn’t shared with anyone that she isn’t related to.

Clove does flinch if you move too quickly around her, especially when moving things or your hands above her head. She does try to grab the lead when going in the kennel with her but will let go once you start walking.

Clove can be anxious around visitors which can cause her to show reactivity and fear aggression. She will need a home with minimal visitors and someone willing to work on these behaviours with her.

Once trusted she is a very affectionate girl who loves belly rubs and cuddles with her favourite people. She loves her snuffle mats and absolutely loves her walks especially if it involves rolling around in the grass.

Clove accepts a collar, harness and lead. She does walk okay however can get between your feet and does pull, she can be easily distracted with food on her walks to prevent any reactions and will mainly ignore everything.

Clove is toilet trained but is not crate trained. She has never been destructive and can be left alone for up to 4 hours with no issues. She also sleeps well overnight.

She however can be very anxious in the car and will panic and try to stay close to people, she has also been known to be sick and froth from the mouth.

name: Cora
description:
Cora is a 7-year-old female Sabueso Hound. She weighs 21.6kg and has a height of 59cm, a length of 101cm, a neck circumference of 42cm, and a chest measurement of 69cm.

She was brought to the shelter because she was not suited for hunting, but she has many qualities that make her a wonderful companion.

Cora is an active and energetic girl who is always happy. She enjoys being around people and other dogs but also appreciates having some time to herself. Her lively nature means she would do well in a home that can provide her with regular exercise and mental stimulation.

She is good with other dogs but prefers to be in charge, so she would be best suited to a home where she can establish her role or with an owner experienced in managing confident dogs.

She is super sweet and sociable with people, making her a loving addition to the right home.

Cora needs some work on lead training as she is quite strong, but she is very obedient, which will help with further training. She travels well in the car, making her an easy companion for trips and outings.

So far, she has shown little interest in cats, but further introductions would be necessary.

Cora is currently in Spain but is available for adoption in the UK. Full rescue backup is provided to support her transition into her forever home. With her affectionate and lively personality, Cora will make a fantastic companion for the right owner.

name: Jamie
description:
Jamie is a 5 month old male Cross-Breed puppy currently based in Cyprus, patiently waiting in kennels for his forever family.

Sweet, baby Jamie is still waiting patiently in our kennels in Cyprus, dreaming of the day his forever family finds him. Despite being overlooked time and time again, we know the right person is out there – someone who will see just how special he truly is.

Jamie is one of the “8 puppies with no mom” – a litter born in heartbreaking circumstances at the beginning of January 2025, with no mother to guide them. But from day one, Jamie has shown incredible strength, resilience, and heart.

Thanks to dedicated care and love, Jamie has grown into a healthy, happy, and wonderfully social pup. He’s playful, affectionate, and already showing signs of becoming the kind of loyal companion families dream of. Jamie is expected to be medium-sized when fully grown – the perfect fit for cuddles on the couch and adventures in the garden.

He’s more than just a puppy – he’s a little survivor, full of love and hope. Now all Jamie needs is someone to believe in him and give him the happiest of endings.

Could you be the one to give Jamie the love he’s been waiting for?

Before travelling to the UK, Jamie will receive a full veterinary check, vaccinations, microchipping, and have his passport prepared.

£155 to reserve Jamie – this allows us to begin his vaccinations and prepare his travel documents.

£385 once his flight is confirmed – this covers transport to the UK.

Our team handles every step of the process to bring Jamie safely home to you. Adopting from abroad is simpler than you may expect – and incredibly rewarding! We’re here to support you throughout, with a dedicated UK team and a large community of adopters across the country.

Interested in Jamie? OUR NEXT FLIGHT IS 15th JUNE, HE COULD BE HOME WITH YOU SOONER THAN YOU MIGHT THINK!

When getting in touch, it helps if you can share a few details:

A brief description of your garden and the lowest fence height

Ages of children in or regularly visiting the home

How long Jamie might be left alone and how he’ll fit into your lifestyle

Please note:Adoption is subject to a satisfactory application, home check, and a commitment to neuter Jamie at the appropriate age (at your own expense).

If your circumstances change, you must notify Dali Dog Rescue UK immediately. Should rehoming become necessary, we will assist in placing Jamie directly from your home or, if needed and space allows, he must be returned to an approved Dali Dog Rescue volunteer.

Dogs may not be transferred to another UK rescue organisation under any circumstances. We are committed to Jamie’s lifelong welfare.

name: Star
description:
Star is a 9-year-old male Cross-Breed. He is medium-sized and currently based in Cheshire. Star is a nervous boy who can be territorial with strangers, so he will need a quiet home with very minimal visitors.

His adopter should be prepared to continue working with him to help build his confidence and provide structure and security.

Star accepts a collar, harness, and lead, and he walks very well. Out and about, he is calm and walks past people and other dogs without issue, showing that his nervousness is mainly centred around the home environment.

He is toilet trained, crate trained, and can be left alone without problems, settling well and sleeping through the night.

In the garden, Star enjoys playing with a tennis ball and is particularly fond of a kong filled with treats. He also has a soft toy he likes to play with when excited before a walk—and sometimes even a shoe.

He can be stubborn at times if he doesn’t want to do something, and treats don’t always work to persuade him. However, with his intelligence and the right handling, he may benefit from further training with someone experienced and patient.

name: Hank
description:
Hank – 3 year old male Anatolian Shepherd Cross-Breed

Hank is a beautiful rescue boy from Cyprus, currently in the Atherstone, West Midlands area and now looking for his forever home. He’s around 37kg, house and crate trained, and travels well in the car.

Hank loves his walks, is good on the lead, and enjoys the company of other dogs. Ideally, he would suit a home where he is an only dog or with a friendly older female dog to show him the ropes and boost his confidence.

He lives alongside a cat currently — while he may chase if the cat runs, he’s happy to coexist peacefully when the cat stays calm.

Hank is a real gentle soul once he bonds with you. He would suit an experienced home with older, dog-savvy children simply due to his size and strength. He has been great in his former home with the young children there.

A secure, safe garden to play and relax in

A quieter environment without too much coming and going

If you think you could be Hank’s perfect match, please get in touch. When contacting us, it would help greatly if you could include:

Information about other pets or dogs in your home

How long Hank would be left alone each day

Minimum adoption donation of £300 applies. Adoption is subject to a satisfactory application, home check, and agreement to our post-adoption policies.

Let’s find Hank the home he truly deserves!

attributes.Breed: Dogue de bordeaux cross labrador retriever

name: Benji
description:
Currently in our kennels in Lancashire but our rescue is in the Reading area. Viewings take place in Lancashire kennels and travel will be funded by us.

Benji is a handsome, happy, and bouncy 16-month-old Dogue de Bordeaux x Labrador looking for an active, loving family to call his own.

This big softie is bursting with personality and adores spending time with his favourite people. He is incredibly affectionate and just wants to be part of the family.

Sadly, Benji has had a very unsettled start to life. In his first year, he was passed around between three different families, bonding with each of them before being moved on again.

His last family made the heartbreaking decision to have him euthanised simply because he had grown too big — something we could not let happen. Benji deserves stability, security, and the chance to finally put down roots with a family who will love him forever.

Despite his rocky start, Benji is a resilient and joyful boy. He is very intelligent, loves learning, and responds brilliantly to training. He thrives when given structure and guidance.

He enjoys enrichment games, sniff and search games, and playing with his ball— it’s one of his absolute favourite activities!

As a young, energetic dog, Benji needs a family who can give him regular exercise, long walks, and plenty of mental stimulation. He is best suited to an active home where he won’t be left alone for long periods and can be involved in daily life.

Benji is great with people and loves meeting new friends. He would do best living with a friendly, calm female dog who can be a positive role model.

He is not suitable to live with cats and will need a home with older, dog-savvy children who are confident around large, bouncy dogs.

This gorgeous boy is currently based in Reading, but potential adopters will need to travel to Lancashire to meet him. Don’t worry — we will fully fund travel costs so you can focus on getting to know him.

Benji’s Ideal Home would be with an active family. He enjoys long walks, playtime, and training.

He would love someone experienced with large breeds who can continue his training. He would benefit from a home with a calm female dog (preferred)

Benji is fully vaccinated, microchipped, and will leave with full rescue back-up for life. You’ll never be alone in supporting him — we’re here to help every step of the way.

Benji is a very special dog with so much love and potential. After being let down so many times, he deserves a forever home where he can finally feel safe and secure.

name: Lucho
description:
Lucho is a 5-year-old male Sabueso Hound. He was born on 28/04/2020 and has found himself in the shelter because he isn’t suited for hunting.

Despite this, Lucho has a lot of qualities that make him a wonderful family companion, and he is simply waiting for the right home to come along.

Lucho weighs 20.2kg, stands at 54cm tall, and is 94cm long, making him a medium-sized dog. He is described as super sweet, although he can be a little shy when meeting new people.

Once he feels secure, his true nature shines through, and he becomes affectionate and loving with those he trusts.

Obedience is one of Lucho’s strong points, and with the right environment, he will quickly settle into family life. He has the makings of an incredibly loyal and devoted pet, eager to share his love with a household that appreciates him.

Full rescue back up is provided, ensuring that support is available to both Lucho and his adopters.

name: Txiru
description:
Txiru is a 7 year old male Sabueso Hound. This beautiful Spanish Hound has had a difficult start in life, which has left him in need of a patient and understanding home.

Despite his hardships, he is now ready for a second chance, looking for a family who can show him kindness and help him feel safe.

Txiru can be shy and fearful around new people, and it will take time for him to build trust. However, when that bond is formed, the reward of seeing him blossom is extraordinary. Gaining his confidence is not only deeply fulfilling but also a real testament to the power of patience and love.

He enjoys the company of other dogs and would benefit from having a calm and gentle canine companion in his new home. With another dog to guide him, Txiru will find it easier to relax and learn that life can be full of comfort and care.

His gentle nature makes him a truly special dog, one who simply needs the right environment to thrive.

Born on 1st January 2018, Txiru still has so much life ahead of him. He is currently in Spain but is fully prepared to travel to the UK to meet his forever family.

His bags are packed, and all he needs now is a loving home where he can finally experience the joy and security he has always deserved.

name: Iona
description:
Iona is a 10 month old female Cross-Breed.

Fostered in Ayr, ScotlandDOB: 28 December 2024Vaccinated, pet passport ready, not yet spayed (too young)

Iona’s story began in Romania, where she was rescued as a tiny puppy with her 2 sisters. Sadly, she spent her whole puppyhood in rescue kennels with not much space or adventure.

Despite this tough start, Iona has grown into a gentle, friendly girl with so much love to give.

She can be a little shy when she first meets new people, but she warms up quickly and soon becomes your number-one fan. Like her sisters, Iona has never lived in a home or walked on a lead, so she’ll need patient owners willing to teach her everything from scratch.

She’ll thrive in an adult-only, rural home with a secure garden, where she can stretch her legs and build her confidence at her own pace. Sweet, beautiful, and playful — Iona just needs her chance to shine.

All three sisters are gentle, sweet, and eager to love. They need dedicated homes willing to guide them through the basics of home life, but the reward will be three incredible companions with hearts as big as their paws.

Think you could give one of these girls their forever home? Apply now at www.savingandrehomingstrays.org

name: Sam
description:
Sam is a 2 to 3-year-old male Cross-Breed. And honestly? He’s basically a 45kg ball of fluff and love — a total teddy bear with a tail.

Despite a rocky chapter in his life, where he was hit by a car and left unable to move, Sam never stopped wagging his tail.

That’s the kind of soul he is: full of gratitude, resilience, and joy, even in the worst of times.

This gentle giant is curious, kind, and downright irresistible. He’s known for being so sweet that even cats feel totally safe around him — which is saying a lot.

Sam is learning about the world with fresh eyes, always smiling and bringing a dose of happiness wherever he goes. His big heart is matched only by his size, and he’s ready to give it all to a forever family.

Sam is vaccinated, blood tested, neutered, flea and worm treated, and microchipped.

Through Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue, he’s waiting patiently for someone to give him the love and security he’s never truly had — and let’s be honest, this big softie will return it tenfold.

name: Islay
description:
Islay is a 10 month old female Cross-Breed.

Fostered in Ayr, ScotlandDOB: 28 December 2024Vaccinated, pet passport ready, not yet spayed (too young)

Islay was rescued in Romania as a tiny pup with her 2 sisters and grew up in cramped rescue kennels without much space to run or play. But now she’s here in Scotland, she’s making up for every missed moment — and she’s doing it with gusto!

The joker of the trio, Islay has absolutely no spatial awareness and barrels through life with oversized enthusiasm. She hasn’t lived in a home or walked on a lead before, so her new family will need patience, commitment, and a good sense of humour.

She’s a big puppy with even bigger energy, so an adult-only home with a large, secure garden is essential — ideally in a rural area where she can zoom to her heart’s content.

Islay may be a big girl but she’s pure joy wrapped in fur and will reward her family with endless laughs and love.

All three sisters are gentle, sweet, and eager to love. They need dedicated homes willing to guide them through the basics of home life, but the reward will be three incredible companions with hearts as big as their paws.

Think you could give one of these girls their forever home?

name: Chupka
description:
Chupka is a 3 year old female Cross-Breed currently under the care of Azil Danica (Network for Animals in Bosnia).

Her name means “Fluffy” — and that is exactly what she is. The softest little cloud with a heart full of sunshine.

Chupka is playful, cheerful, and always open to new people and experiences. She walks beautifully on the lead, loves every dog she meets, and pays no attention to cats.

She is the kind of dog that makes every day brighter — a happy soul ready to share her joy with someone who will finally call her their own.

Application and home check apply.Rescue support and backup in the UK via Meadow of Hope Dog Rescue.

name: Collar
description:
Collar is a medium sized crossbreed male aged around 3 years old. Collar fostered Norwich, Norfolk.

This handsome guy was new in the Botosani public shelter on our most recent trip. He was wearing a collar so he obviously had an owner before he ended up in there.

Collar loves his walks and attention from people. He was happy to see us as soon as we went into the small pen he was sharing with several other dogs.

Collar is looking for his own forever home and would suit many home environments. He needs someone fairly active as he is young and quite collie like. He needs a bit of training as he does jump up at present but we have started to correct this.

Collar can live with or without other dogs. He can live with children 10 and over. He is not yet cat tested.

name: Bonnie
description:
Bonnie is a small sized crossbreed aged around 6 years old. Bonnie, fostered Norwich, Norfolk.

Bonnie was found in the Botosani public shelter during our recent visit. She was immediately happy to make friends with us when we went in her pen and gets on with other dogs.

Bonnie enjoys going for a walk and is looking for a home who will help her experience everything she has missed out on.

Bonnie can live with or without other dogs. She can live with children 10 and over. She is not yet cat tested.

name: Ellen
description:
Ellen is a small to medium sized crossbreed aged around 2 years old.Ellen, fostered Norwich, Norfolk.

We met Ellen on our recent visit to the Botosani public shelter and she is such a friendly girl.

As soon as we met her we knew she would make a super addition to a loving family home.

She already knew how to walk on a lead and really loves people so we feel she did have an owner. We are unsure how she ended up in the shelter but she has certainly kept her sunny personality.

Ellen can live with or without other dogs. She would like a fairly active home and can live with children 10 and over. She is not yet cat tested.

name: Magda
description:
MAGDA – NOTHING TO FIX. EVERYTHING TO LOVE

Magda is a young female Cross-Breed who is small to medium in size.

Magda was one of the smaller ones. Small enough to disappear in a kill shelter cage full of bigger dogs, in a place where the weakest vanish so quickly.

She didn’t disappear. We went into that kill shelter and carried her out. And the little girl in our arms turned out to be pure sweetness.

She is gentle, cuddly and soft with everyone she meets. She loves people. She is wonderful with children. She gets along with every dog around her.

She has no difficult side. No fear to work through. Nothing to fix.

She just wants to be close. At someone’s feet. In someone’s arms. Pressed against someone on the sofa. That is her whole wish: a home where she is no longer the one in the corner, but the one everyone reaches for first.

She was almost lost in that kill shelter. She deserves to be held forever.

Female, youngSmall to medium sizeSweet, cuddly and gentleWonderful with childrenLoves peopleGreat with other dogsThe ideal family dog

HealthySpayedFully vaccinated4D testedBrucellosis tested

She could have been lost in that kill shelter cage. In the right home, she will be the most loved.

name: Teddy
description:
Our extra special boy Teddy is approximately three years old and a really small cross breed with a hint of Kokoni. Teddy weighs just five kilos and measures ten inches from shoulder to paw.

Sadly, Teddy’s owner passed away a couple of weeks ago and he was surrendered to our Cyprus shelter.

It is always incredibly difficult for a dog to adjust to shelter life having been preloved and in their forever home.

Teddy is coping incredibly well despite being overwhelmed and surrounded by other dogs who are mostly much larger than him and certainly noisier.

He has an exceptionally sweet and endearing personality with show stopping looks and a natural kindness and empathy about him.

Teddy’s natural gentility makes him the most obvious adoption candidate. His puppy dog eyes soft light tan coat and curly tail makes Teddy everyone’s favourite.

Teddy walks nicely and easily on his lead and enjoys his time in the car. He appears to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Kiera
description:
Kiera is a 2½ year old female Bulldog Cross currently located in Berkshire and searching for her forever home.

Meet Kiera, our stunning Bulldog Cross with the softest eyes and the biggest heart. At just 2½ years old, Kiera has already experienced more than most dogs her age — but she’s taken it all in her stride with her trademark smile and a tail that never stops wagging.

Kiera is one of those dogs who wins you over instantly. She’s loving, gentle, and incredibly people-focused — happiest when she’s near her humans, whether that’s playing outside, snoozing at your feet, or rolling over for belly rubs. She thrives on affection and gives it right back tenfold.

She’s brilliant with children and adores being part of family life. Despite her strong build, Kiera has a soft, calm temperament and responds beautifully to reassurance and gentle handling.

She loves fuss, cuddles, and simply being included. Kiera has an outstanding temperament and is happy just to curl up on a comfy sofa — being next to her human is enough for her.

Kiera has come such a long way since arriving with us. She’s fully vaccinated, microchipped, and doing really well on lead walks.

She’s curious about the world, loves exploring new smells, and enjoys meeting friendly people and dogs on her walks. Kiera is not a high-energy dog — 30-minute walks twice a day are ample exercise for her.

She’s currently around 35 kg — a healthy girl with a big personality and an even bigger heart. Kiera rides nicely in the crate in the car, settles well after walks, and has shown no issues around food or other dogs.

Kiera would thrive in a loving, stable home where she can finally relax and feel part of the family. She’d suit:

• A home where someone is around most of the day (she loves company).• Families with children, or adults who enjoy active, affectionate dogs.• Possibly living with another calm, well-balanced dog (subject to introductions).

She’s happiest when she has routine, gentle guidance, and time to unwind. Once she trusts you — which doesn’t take long — she’ll be your loyal shadow and best friend.

From her foster carer:“Kiera is just the sweetest girl. She loves to sit with you and has the funniest little grin when she’s happy. She’s got so much love to give — she deserves a home that will adore her for the rest of her life.”

Kiera is ready to start her next chapter — one filled with warmth, safety, and love. If you think you could offer her the home she deserves, please reach out.

name: Benny
description:
Our extra special boy Benny is approximately five or maybe six years old and a perfect sized cross breed towards the bottom end of medium.

Benny weighs fifteen kilos and measures fourteen inches from shoulder to paw. Having been found abandoned on the streets Benny has been in our Cyprus shelter for a little over two months.

As the dearest and sweetest of little dogs Benny has clearly been preloved and is consequently baffled and overwhelmed by shelter life.

The cruellest thing that could happen to a dog, Benny is struggling to understand what has happened to him, why he has lost his home and family.

Hidden beneath this fear and anguish is a charming and personable character that oozes calmness and gentility.

Benny lightens up the room and his stunning appearance draws attention and admiration. With his incredibly handsome face, beautiful ears and puppy dog eyes, Benny is the star of any show.

After a short period of adjustment accompanied by a calm and regular routine Benny will again become a warm and loving family member. An incredible prize for his fortune adopters.

Benny walks nicely on his lead and enjoys his time in the car. He seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Scout
description:
Scout, UK Surrender, A Bouncy Boy Saved from Danger, Looking for Safety and Kindness. Located Leicester LE9.

Scout is a cheerful and sweet-natured about 10 months old Labrador cross, still just a big puppy in need of guidance and security. He’s a large-sized boy with an even larger heart.

Rescue Story:A rather strange and sad tale – Scout was reportedly rescued from an act of cruelty. A woman told us she saved him from a man who intended to drown him. But although she saved his life, she couldn’t keep him. Her dog was not accepting him.

She found him a home but after 1 night they said he is too energetic for them and there 3 years old daughter scared of him. She was calling all Rescue places and nobody could help.

She was so desperate and so grateful when our Foster agreed to take him on.He was passed on again, landing in an emergency foster who kindly stepped in. Now Scout needs a stable place where he will be loved.

Detailed Information:Scout is very much a typical young Lab cross – friendly, excitable, loves people, and adores a good game of fetch. His whole body wags when he sees other dogs, and he’s keen to make friends.

He is used to living indoors. On the lead, he’s surprisingly good – pulls but manageable, just enthusiasm for life. He eats dry biscuits but would no doubt enjoy a tastier menu.

Scout does not like being shouted at or overwhelmed – he’s still learning how to be confident and secure, and a calm, consistent routine will help him flourish. At this stage, he’s better suited to a home without very young children, just to ensure he feels relaxed and safe.

We don’t recommend pairing male dogs to prevent potential competition, even if it hasn’t been an issue in the past. Prevention is always better.

Ideal Family:Scout needs a loving, calm household – ideally with access to a secure garden, and people home more often than not. He’d love to play, explore, and learn new things in a safe and positive environment. A dog-savvy family with older children or a kind female dog companion would be ideal.

Scout is young, impressionable, and full of hope. With the right people by his side, he’ll blossom into a loyal, happy companion. He’s not had the easiest start, but he’s been gentle through it all – eager for love, eager to belong.

Could you be the calm voice and steady hand that gives him that second chance?

Health Information:Scout is currently healthy but not yet neutered. He will be neutered once assessed and settled in foster. Vaccination and microchipping will also be arranged.

RBU, post-adoption support, and 4 weeks free PetPlan insurance provided upon adoption.

name: Zena
description:
Zena is a 9 month old female large and lean Cross-Breed currently with Forget Me Not Reading Rescues.

Zena is our absolutely stunning girl who captures hearts everywhere she goes. With her sleek, jet-black coat that shimmers in the light and those soulful, intelligent eyes, she’s as beautiful on the outside as she is inside.

Her expressive face and elegant build make her truly striking — she’s a head-turner who stands out for all the right reasons.

Zena isn’t just a pretty face, though. She’s full of playful puppy energy and has a wonderful zest for life. Whether she’s bounding through the grass, exploring new smells, or leaning in for cuddles, she does everything with pure enthusiasm.

She loves people and thrives on human company, soaking up affection and attention wherever she can.

Zena is also great with other dogs and enjoys socialising, so she could happily live alongside another friendly, confident dog after successful introductions.

She’s still a youngster and learning her way in the world, so she’ll need ongoing positive training, gentle guidance, and consistency as she matures — but she’s a bright, eager girl who’s keen to please.

She travels well once settled, enjoys her walks, and loves spending time with those she trusts. A home that can offer her both mental and physical stimulation will bring out her very best.

• Regular walks, play, and adventures• Continued training and positive reinforcement• A secure garden to zoom around and relax in• Plenty of love and reassurance as she grows in confidence

She could live with older, sensible children who understand she’s still learning and respect her space when she needs it.

Zena’s combination of beauty, brains, and boundless love makes her an absolute gem. She has so much potential to blossom into a loyal, affectionate companion for a family who can match her energy and give her the time and patience she deserves.

Zena — sleek, shiny, and stunning inside and out. Ready to bring joy, laughter, and love to her forever home.

name: Lila
description:
Lila is a 4-year-old female Shepherd Cross. She’s a gentle, soulful girl with a calm and steady heart, now under the care of Azil Danica through the Network for Animals in Bosnia.

At 29 kilograms and 53 centimetres tall, she’s a medium-sized beauty with a quiet, graceful presence that instantly brings peace to those around her.

Lila has an incredibly even temperament — she never reacts to other dogs or cats and is wonderfully patient and calm around children. Her gentle nature and soft heart make her an ideal companion for anyone looking for a loyal, peaceful friend to share their life with.

Life hasn’t always been kind to Lila. She came from a harsh old shelter where survival was all she knew, and sadly, she’s spent much of her life being overlooked. Despite everything, she’s remained grateful, kind, and quietly hopeful for a chance at real love.

There’s something special about dogs like Lila — the ones who don’t demand attention but win your heart with their quiet strength.

She may not be the flashy, outgoing type, but she’s full of warmth and steady devotion. She’s ready for someone who will finally see her for the extraordinary dog she is.

Lila is fully vaccinated, blood tested, spayed, microchipped, and treated for fleas and worms. She’s also been ELISA brucellosis lab tested, so her adopters can have full confidence in her health.

She’s searching for a kind, understanding home that values her gentle soul. Lila would do beautifully in a calm environment where her loving nature can truly shine.

Rescue support and backup are available in the UK, and home checks and adoption applications apply.

This lovely girl has waited long enough — now it’s time for her to be noticed and cherished for the wonderful companion she’s always been.

name: Ben
description:
Welcome Ben, a gentle 7 year old male Cross-Breed with a heart full of potential.

Ben is a medium-sized boy (just 18kg) who’s looking for an understanding and experienced owner who can offer him the peace and patience he needs to thrive.

Rescued just in time from a kill shelter, Ben has already been through so much.

Despite his difficult past, he’s made incredible progress during his rehabilitation at CHR, and he’s now ready to take the next step in his journey to happiness.

Ben would thrive in a quiet, calm home with no children, where he can feel safe and secure.

While he’s been temperamental in the past, he’s shown that with patience and care, he can open up to people and build trust.

He’s also comfortable living with a calm female dog who shares his gentle energy.

Ben’s reactivity comes from his past experiences, but at just 18kg, he’s a manageable size for someone with experience.

With a calm, understanding owner, Ben has the potential to become a devoted and loving companion. He simply needs someone to believe in him and give him the chance he’s been waiting for.

Male, approximately 7 years old • Medium size, 18kg • Currently in Romania but ready to travel • Fully blood-tested, vaccinated, and neutered • Full RBU and support from Pennypaws Rescue and a homecheck is required

Ben is a quiet, soulful boy who just needs the right home to flourish. Could you be the one to show him what love and security feel like?

Ben has already come so far—now he just needs someone to help him find his happily ever after. Could you be his perfect match?

name: Daniel
description:
Daniel is a 4-month-old male Cross-Breed. This little pup is the full package—playful, confident, and ridiculously cute.

He was rescued in Romania after being abandoned with his mum and sibling, but thankfully he’s now thriving in a loving foster home.

Expected to grow to a small to medium size like his 14kg mum, Daniel is already showing off his bold personality.

He adores people, loves sprinting through long grass like he’s in a shampoo commercial, and can’t get enough of his toys or his sibling’s company.

Daniel is ready to pack his tiny bag and catch a ride to his forever home. He dreams of a place with a secure garden to zoom around in, a stash of toys to destroy (lovingly, of course), and a cozy bed to crash in after a long day of being adorable.

Most importantly, he needs a family who’ll be patient as he adjusts to life outside of rescue.

He’s been microchipped, vaccinated, blood tested, and treated for fleas and worms—so he’s basically got his suitcase packed and passport stamped. All that’s left is you.

name: Tessa and Tosca
description:
Tessa and Tosca are 5 year old female Cross-Breeds. They must live in a child-free, pet-free, and dog-free home and would ideally be rehomed together. Tessa and Tosca were in a shelter together for 3 years before coming under our care.

During that time they were well cared for but did not receive as much human attention as they perhaps needed. As a result, they came to us as very timid pups and have both been adopted separately and come back to us as they were too timid apart to live in a home.

We would therefore love to see these girls adopted together as they rely on each other for their confidence.

At the rescue they enjoy playing, sleeping, and cuddling.

Tessa and Tosca have done a little lead training at the rescue, but we would need a family willing to put in the time and effort to gain their trust and work on their training slowly and with our support.

We know it’s a big ask to find these two a home together, but we like to dream big for our dogs.

name: Bullet
description:
Bullet is a young male bull lurcher; about 15 months old and 27″ to the shoulder.

Bullet is fine with children (but too boisterous to be rehomed with very young kids because he might knock them over).

Toilet trained. (but currently in kennels, so may need to readjust to being in a home again)

Bullet is being trained to walk nicely on a lead – currently he pulls quite strongly.

Any new owner will need to be prepared to continue with this training.

Bullet shows some signs of distress at being left so will need patient new owners who are around for much of the time (at least to start with); and who are prepared take time to build up how long he is left home alone.

Bullet is at LURCHER LINK RESCUE, near Halifax, West Yorkshire.

name: Florica
description:
Florica is a 9 year old male Cross-Breed and is a wise and wonderful senior chap who’s ready for a peaceful and loving forever home.

With his soft eyes and gentle presence, he brings a calm warmth to any room he enters. While he may have a few grey hairs, he has plenty of life, love, and tail wags left to give.

Florica enjoys the simpler things in life: cozy naps, leisurely strolls in quiet areas to build lead confidence, and the company of kind humans. He’s especially fond of sniffing out new scents along his path—it’s his way of exploring the world and enjoying the moment.

Florica is well-mannered, and past the puppy chaos stage. Florica would thrive in a calm household with someone who appreciates the quiet companionship of a senior dog.

He’s great with gentle people and would do well with another calm dog companion.

If you’re looking for a calm, wise companion who’ll adore you with all his heart, Florica might just be your perfect match.

Adoption ready: Yes, Florica has had his blood tests and vaccines and is ready to travel

Florica is looking for a loving home at a reduced adoption donation of £200 from Romania with vet preparation and home drop off.

Let’s give Florica the peaceful retirement he truly deserves.
